title: Proud Mankind’s Technology Just Reached Its End
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, nabi akhirizzamaan Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammad wa aalihi wa saahbihi ajma`een wa man tabi`ahum bi-ihsaan ila
yawm ad-deen.
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O Attenders! O Mankind! Our attenders from east to west, from north to south, Allah Almighty gave all of
Mankind honor and created them as the most honored ones among His creatures.
O People! Hear, listen, and obey. Try to believe in Who created you, your souls, and your physical beings;
think on it, and give thanks to our Lord, our Creator! The most glory and most might are for Allah. Don't try
to ask about His Existence. However, now people are drunk ones, never using their mentalities. Before asking
about Allah Almighty's Being, ask about yourself! Do you know who you are or from where and how you
came? What do you know about this life? Also, ask how you will leave this life. What is the real meaning of
dying? Everyone is going to die, so ask, “How am I living and how will I die?”

People are not asking this, but rather, “Who is Allah? Where is He?” People living in the 21st century ask such
foolish questions, even before asking about their own identities! He is The One Who created you!!! Do you
know how you were created and reached this age, seeing, hearing, thinking, and understanding? Why aren’t
you using your understanding to about know yourself, to ask, "Who am I? How am I here?" Allah, Allah.

SubhaanAllah.
O People! Throughout east and west, from north to south, throughout continents and across oceans, since
one week everything changed. Such huge and terrible events occurred, which you know about and are
trembling! Just one week ago, last Friday, an unexpected event happened in the last point of continents in the
Far East, where an ocean meets another continent.
The Pacific Ocean is vast. Sometimes, people question me in a way to show their knowledge. I know nothing,
so I say, “I do not know, but you say you know everything, so tell me how many buckets of water are in that
Pacific Ocean and from where is that water brought?” Why are they not thinking on it? They only know, "We
come from Earth and return to Earth." Is that your full knowledge?
They say, "O Shaykh! We think the Atlantic Ocean has too many buckets of water compared to the Pacific
Ocean, therefore, we are digging another place and taking buckets and putting them there. That is our
knowledge."
La ilaaha illa-Llah! They are saying Earth, this globe, is like a football. How is the Pacific Ocean not falling
down? They have no answer, but ask, "Who is Allah?" Leave that, and give me an answer! How is the Pacific
Ocean keeping its waters? "We don't know." You don't know the answer! One week ago, perhaps there was
too much water in the Pacific Ocean and not enough room for angels; therefore, it spread on Japan. Yes,
there was too much water, so coming and taking.
What happened to Japan? In Japan, all they do is sit, sleep, eat, work, and think about creating new
technology and what features it will have! Japan was the first nation to use nuclear power. Russia, China,
even Germany and England are beneath Japan in nuclear development. Japan said, "I am the first in
technology and through it we can do everything as we like." They did not say, “That is a power that Allah
Almighty is giving authority for us to use; that is from our Lord.” Rather, they said, "We are bringing that

power through our minds and our own knowledge. We found it and are using it as we like.” They did not
attribute that power to Allah Almighty, and last week that tsunami came.
Pakistani people claim they are the cleverest ones, saying, "We know how to make such things," and Japan is
saying, "No, we know more." Japan builds nuclear power there. Tawbah, astaghfirullahi l-`Azheem. One
wave came from the Pacific Ocean and woooooo, it covered Japan!!!
O Our Scientists! Where are you, our proud, learned doctors and professors? You never think about such
things. They may put a tower like Nimrood and say, "With this power, we can control everything on Earth as
we like." SubhaanAllahi l-`Adheem.
Today one heavenly inspiration is coming to me, saying, "O Shaykh! What do you think about last week’s
event?" I see that from Friday up to Friday everything changed: their mentalities, their knowledge, and their
controls on nature! Now they are examining their claims to have such massive nuclear power, and nuclear
radiation (is leaking from their damaged reactors). Mankind was very proud to have reached such high
power, saying, “With this power we can do as we like.”
What happened? Today heavenly knowledge is coming because that nuclear radiation was making Mankind
proud by showing power, but now their power has reached the last point. They claimed, "We may control
everything on this Earth and will not allow anyone to control us!" They reached the last point of kufr,
unbelief, then one tsunami took away their nuclear centers.
Some news is prompting me to pray two raka`ats, to thank the Lord of Heavens. I heard today that the
German government ordered some nuclear radiation centers closed! That means they reached the top point
and there is no more chance for them. They are beginning to destroy those power stations with their own
hands (before it goes) out of their control. They reached the peak of technology and are beginning to come
down; that means technology is defeated now and is beginning to come down to the zero point. That makes
me so happy, muntahah! I reached the top point of being happy, because the pride of Mankind is now broken
down and the German government has ordered reactors shut down!
Now there is no chance for Mankind to be proud or to trust technology. The German government ordered
nuclear reactors closed, because when Mahdi (a) comes (Mawlana Shaykh stands) he will say, “Allahu Akbar.

Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar,” and all nuclear and electric-based technology will finish! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Grandshaykh (q) said to me, "Nazim Effendi, when Mahdi (a) comes and says, ‘Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar.
Allahu Akbar,’ all technology will come to the zero point.” That is beginning now, which means the time of
Mahdi (a) is approaching!
Alhamdulllah. Yaa Rabbee, shukr. Yaa Rabbee, shukr. Just now I am going to pray two raka`ats for this
purpose, that this (era) is finishing. Alhamdulillah, technology has died! Now no one in government,
professors, or scientists, can hope to control anything on Earth, and they must leave (acknowledge) every
control to Heavens. There is no more control for people, and no more control for Shaytan and its followers,
alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah!
O People! Throughout east and west, hear this message and keep yourselves (following heavenly orders), or
another slap (disaster) will come and you will not know from where. Now they are saying radiation fallout in
Japan is coming to California and they are asking to use iodine to prevent its harm. Even without radiation or
nuclear acitivity (it is written that) people will fall down dead; billions are going to die, as Grandshaykh (q)
said, “From five people, one will remain and four will die.”
O People! Keep yourselves! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Say, “Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar wa
lillahi 'l-hamd!” (Mawlana Shaykh sits) or else you will be taken away (with those who are condemned)! Don't
say, “Libya has so many hundreds of people (and not that many have died),” or, “Japan has so many
thousands of people (and only a fraction of their people were killed),” no, no! So many people are going to
die: from five billion only one billion will remain. Keep your understanding (of these events)! If you do not
understand it here, now, you will be made to understand it in your grave!
I am declaring this to the chief of Christianity, to my friend, His Holiness, the Pope, and to every religious
leader. I am saying they should remind people that the Last Day, the Day of Resurrection, is coming.
O People! Come to Allah! Come and say, “O our Lord! We are Your weak servants. Give Your blessings to us.
Send us someone to take our wrongs away and to bring good ones for us.” Try to be good ones. Don't try to be
with Shaytan; he is finished now, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!

O People! May Allah forgive us.
Fatihah.
In Germany five nuclear reactors were closed, never to be opened again. Those are the biggest good tidings!
This must be heard throughout the east and west. All religious people, leaders, or sects of beliefs must declare
this to their followers. If not, they will be the first to go away to the ocean, and the ocean is now ready to
swallow entire continents! If a heavenly order commands the ocean, “Stand up five hundred meters and go
on,” the five continents will be under water! Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. One tsunami needs
only one second to cover five continents and all of them will be under water!
O People! Fear Allah, or you will be under that! It is not ordinary water; it’s temperature is not 30 or 40
degrees Celsius, it is 1,000 degrees Celsius! That will be like the black waves that came over Japan, and when
that happens everything will melt, and you won’t find any bones or even a trace from Mankind as they will be
inside the tsunami.
O People! Come to Allah, and fear Him! Cypriots, Turks, Russians, Libya, people of Hijaaz, everyone
everywhere must fear. This is a very strong declaration and it is not coming from my mindly production.
Amaan, yaa Rabbee. Amaan, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, astaghfirullah!
Fatihah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah.
What I am saying now is something you cannot imagine. They are making me speak on something that no
one can think on it, taking away everything from your minds and suddenly coming, finishing.
O People! Keep your adab with Allah Almighty; if not, everything will be taken away. Allah, Allah. Amaan, yaa
Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee.

Fatihah.
I will pray two raka`ats now to thank Allah Almighty that technology is defeated and finished. This (suhbah)
is very important.
Fatihah.
